questions.question: What was the Columbian exchange?
options: The transfer of plants, animals, human populations, diseases, and culture between the Old World and New World
A trade agreement between Portugal and Spain
The exchange of goods between Europe and Africa only
A series of naval battles in the Atlantic
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says, "This exchange involved the transfer of plants, animals, human populations (including slaves), communicable diseases, and culture across the Eastern and Western Hemispheres".
Incorrect. The Columbian exchange is not described as a trade agreement between Portugal and Spain.
Incorrect. The exchange involved the Old World (Europe, Asia, Africa) and the New World (Americas), not just Europe and Africa.
